reel.cBig: Let it, leave it, have it done — all lassen.
reel.cEx: Ich lasse den Schlüssel zu Hause.
reel.cTrans: = I leave the key at home. (ich lasse · du lässt · er lässt)

caption:
The German verb with five jobs 🤯 — 'lassen' means to let, to leave, to allow, to have something done… and it builds half of everyday German.
Ich lasse den Schlüssel zu Hause. = I leave the key at home.
ich lasse · du lässt · er/sie/es lässt
